themes.evidence: Our success depends upon our customers' success.
The Fourth Industrial Revolution is changing the way people work, using robotics, AI, the Internet of Things, and more.
Together, we're creating a future of new opportunities.
We believe everyone can be a Trailblazer, and we're building the technology to make it happen.

linguistic_shift: The addition of 'We believe everyone can be a Trailblazer, and we're building the technology to make it happen.' and 'Together, we're creating a future of new opportunities.' shifts the emphasis towards empowering individuals and collective progress.
